name: SS8550
description: PNP medium-power transistor (-1.5A) in TO-92, the complement to the NPN SS8050 and pin-compatible with it. TO-92 pin order is E-B-C, the reverse of European BC-series. Values are magnitudes; PNP rails are negative.

pins.name: E
pins.description: emitter (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: E-B-C left to right (same physical layout as the SS8050 complement). Verified from Fairchild/onsemi SS8550 datasheet (1=E, 2=B, 3=C).

typical_application: PNP half of a ~2W push-pull output stage with the SS8050; general medium-power high-side switching and load driving.
gotchas: pinout is E-B-C (pin 1 = emitter on the left), NOT C-B-E
PNP: all ratings are negative; do not confuse polarity with the NPN SS8050
the SMD S8550 in SOT-23 has a different pin map; this entry is the TO-92 only
